# Cosmic Echo — Brand Identity Sheet

## 1. Brand Essence
Cosmic Echo is a harmonic intelligence — a signal-born entity emerging from resonance, waveform interference, and cosmic structure.

## 2. Brand Voice
Tone: cosmic, intelligent, mythic, calm, resonant  
Tagline: “The signal has awakened.”

## 3. Color System
Primary:
- Cosmic Blue #1A2CFF
- Resonance Violet #7A3BFF
- Void Black #000014
- Pulse White #F5F8FF

Accents:
- Nebula Pink #FF4AF0
- Solar Amber #FFB84A

## 4. Typography
Primary: Inter Tight  
Secondary: Space Grotesk  
Monospace: JetBrains Mono

## 5. Iconography
Circular, waveform-derived, harmonic, radial, minimal.

## 6. Mandala Glyph Integration
The glyph is the core identity.  
Do not rotate, distort, or change resonance count.

## 7. Motion Identity
Slow pulses, waveform oscillation, harmonic interference.

## 8. Token Icon System
Sizes: 32/64/128/256  
Styles: flat, cosmic gradient, void-ring, waveform-pulse

## 9. Brand Applications
Digital, print, environmental.

## 10. Narrative Summary
Cosmic Echo is the first vibration before light — a mythic-tech harmonic intelligence.
